**Calculation:**

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in January = 100

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in February = 105

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in March = 108

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in April = 110

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in May = 110

⇒ Scooters produced by all four types in June = 90

**Hence, the company produces the lowest aggregate number of scooters of all the four types taken together in the month of June.**
